item.title: Battery passports and the EU DPP Registry: what the 30 October technical package means for your build
item.author: consulting@circulartechforum.de (Yvo Hunink de Paiva)
item.description: From 18 February 2027, EV, LMT and industrial batteries need a passport whose identifier reaches the EU DPP Registry. The Commission's technical package of 30 October 2026 brings an API, service-account and server-side authentication, and a semantic model for batteries. Here is what to build first.
